marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Wind east 20 knots except east 30 over southeastern sections
tonight. Wind diminishing to east 15 early Saturday evening. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Saturday.
marine.text:
Outside the ice edge seas 2 to 3 metres subsiding to 1 to 2
Saturday morning and to 1 Saturday evening.<br/>
